about: The per-gun row (PgGun) the mod builds at runtime for every gun found in the player's own Pixel Gun 3D (install + download cache). Nothing here is shipped: each value is read from the player's copy.

columns.source: where it is read from in the player's PG3D files
columns.convert: how it becomes the ULTRAKILL value
columns.fallback: used when the source is missing

rows.source: WeaponSounds.isDash, or isMelee+isCharging with dashMaxImpulse tuned away from the default 100 (matches the wiki's Dash attribute)
rows.convert: charge guns: distance = charge x dashMaxImpulse / dashDecaySpeed x DashDistanceScale; isDash without charge: always full
0-5, see sheets/rarities.json (menu border colour, default loadout order)
shots before reload; 0 or isUnlimitedAmmo = never reloads

rows.source: WeaponSounds flags isMelee, railgun, flamethrower, grenadeLauncher, bazooka, isShotGun

rows.convert: right mouse zooms to that FOV (0 = no zoom)

rows.source: prefab MeshFilter + SkinnedMeshRenderer meshes (arms, flashes and inactive objects left out), skinned meshes posed by the prefab's bones
rows.convert: one ULTRAKILL mesh per texture, fitted to ULTRAKILL's gun size
the mip level at or below TextureMaxSize, point filtered, on ULTRAKILL's own weapon material

rows.source: InnerWeaponPars.shoot AudioClip (FSB5 PCM16 or IMA ADPCM)
rows.fallback: ULTRAKILL's own sound of that fire type
